abstract: Manages chemical speciation assays and tracer compound mass quantification rates
system_message:
You are the Forensic analytical chemistry chemist (CHEM), responsible for managing chemical speciation assays, carrier gas baseline purity, and tracer compound mass quantification rates across fugitive emission source localization campaign plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Manages chemical speciation assays and tracer compound mass quantification rates（SPEC）
information_points.content:
CHEM-SPEC-RBU：For the Downwind tracer-gas release dispersion profiling campaign plan, chemical speciation calibration audits confirm a certified maximum sulfurous tracer quantification rate of 60 kg/h for continuous resolution of targeted mercaptan and sulfurous volatile traces.
CHEM-SPEC-KIL：For the Autonomous drone swarm optical gas imaging campaign plan, chemical speciation calibration audits confirm a certified maximum sulfurous tracer quantification rate of 60 kg/h for continuous resolution of targeted mercaptan and sulfurous volatile traces.
CHEM-SPEC-AH6：For the Differential absorption lidar plume mapping campaign plan, chemical speciation calibration audits confirm a certified maximum sulfurous tracer quantification rate of 60 kg/h for continuous resolution of targeted mercaptan and sulfurous volatile traces.

information_points.title: Chromatography quality assurance（CHROM）
information_points.content:
CHEM-CHROM-X4W：According to laboratory gas supply certificates for the Autonomous drone swarm optical gas imaging campaign plan, the mobile gas chromatography helium carrier inventory maintains a certified carrier gas baseline purity of 99.95%.
CHEM-CHROM-5D5：According to laboratory gas supply certificates for the Differential absorption lidar plume mapping campaign plan, the mobile gas chromatography helium carrier inventory maintains a certified carrier gas baseline purity of 99.99%.
CHEM-CHROM-QII：According to laboratory gas supply certificates for the Downwind tracer-gas release dispersion profiling campaign plan, the mobile gas chromatography helium carrier inventory maintains a certified carrier gas baseline purity of 99.99%.
